Package dev.relism.flash

Class App

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.App
public final class App extends Object
What you build: routes, middleware, modules and the services they need. A value with no port and no thread; a Server runs it, and a test runs the very same one. 

 static App api(Database db) {
     return App.create()
             .install(new JsonModule(), new DataModule(db))
             .add(Users.class)
             .scan("com.acme.api")
             .get("/healthz", (req, res) -> "ok");
 }

 Server.start(api(db), ServerConfig.builder().port(8080).build());

Every app has its own services, so several apps live in one process without sharing anything they were not handed.
